# The selection criteria are a declared, recorded discipline

## The rule

Selection at the gate weighs candidates against the criteria this record
declares, and only these.

- Plausibility — the conjecture could work by a mechanism we can state.
- Generativity — pursuing it opens further conjectures rather than closing them.
- Cost — what building and carrying it consumes, stated before selection.

## The gate

The criteria come from this record and no criterion arrives at invocation.
